# Paris Institutional Markets Event 2026 brings together clients and market experts to discuss the outlook for global markets

Santander Corporate & Investment Banking (Santander CIB) hosted its Paris Institutional Markets Event 2026, bringing together institutional clients and leading market experts to explore the key trends influencing global yields, credit markets and investment strategies.


Hosted by **Mike Bagguley** , Global Head of Markets at Santander CIB, the event featured **Vincent Mortier** , Chief Investment Officer at Amundi, **Delphine Di Pizio-Tiger** , Chief Executive Officer of Indosuez Gestion, and **Antonio Garcia Pascual** , Global Head of Economics at Santander CIB, who shared their perspectives on how fiscal pressures, geopolitical developments and evolving market dynamics are shaping the investment landscape.


The programme also included a discussion on the geopolitical environment led by **Laurence Boone** , Head of the Paris Branch at Santander CIB, examining the implications of global developments for markets and investors.


The event concluded with a panel discussion led by **José M. Linares** , Senior Executive Vice-President of Santander and Global Head of Santander CIB, bringing together the key themes and perspectives discussed throughout the session.


The Paris Institutional Markets Event provided an opportunity for clients, investors and market specialists to exchange views, strengthen relationships and gain insights into the factors shaping investment decisions in an increasingly complex global environment.
